notes: The parts list (367 pieces) excludes minifigure parts, so minifigs are not modelled; the briefcase (b7) is a minifig accessory and is tied to the platform with a loose placement join.
Parts are numbered in physical stacking order, so a piece attached underneath another (the wheel holders b8/b9 under the draisine plate b10) is listed first and the plate rests on it.

Bag 1: hand truck with parcel (b1-b6), draisine (b8-b28) and four straight tracks (b29-b32). Bag 2: platform base, deck, seats, sign, ticket machine, map board and canopy (b33-b158). Bag 3: module A (b159-b204). Bag 4: module B (b205-b256). Bag 5: roof, table and tower (b257-b367).

The booklet builds one display scene: the platform, the station building, the track with the draisine and the hand truck are separate sub-models placed side by side on page 71. They are not clicked together, so they are joined with 'loose' placement joins (building against the platform, platform against the track, draisine on the track, hand truck and briefcase on the deck) so the graph is one connected model. Within each sub-model the pieces are genuinely fastened.

Several fine details were hard to read from the small drawings, so these are best guesses with correct part counts: which exact pillars the sign and canopy beams sit on, the order of yellow bricks in the walls, the roof slopes, the blue-pin/clip arrangement in the draisine, and where the Technic pin 32002 sits.
The single sticker sheet (b6) is used on the parcel and the map panel.
